similar_pairs.b_text: Before you even think about interpreting what your altered state of consciousness is, ask yourself something simpler:

similar_pairs.a_text: The mind of love and the mind of analysis can both be there, so you can be warm and clear-headed at once. The mind of intuition and the mind of rationality can both be there - intuitive signals without dogma, and testing of those signals without killing them. The body can have a voice - saying yes or no or not yet. The imagination can open up the field, and then the adult can choose what to do next in the real world. You can be at peace and still be precise.
similar_pairs.b_text: Without the mind of love, the mind of analysis can be sterile. Without the mind of analysis, the mind of love can lead to fantasy. Without testing, intuitive signals can become delusions. Without intuitive signals, the testing can be dead. So these modes can correct each other.

similar_pairs.a_text: If you’re having chest pain, fainting, suicidal thoughts, psychosis-like symptoms, mania-like symptoms, severe dissociative symptoms, not being able to sleep, wanting to hurt yourself or somebody else, etc., then you need to get professional help. similar_pairs.b_text: You should get help now if you are in imminent danger, if you are very confused, if you cannot ensure your own safety, and/or if you are experiencing concerning physical symptoms (e.g., chest pain, fainting, etc). You should also seek professional help promptly if you are experiencing new or worsening suicidal thoughts, severe insomnia, new or worsening manic or psychotic symptoms, or if dissociative symptoms are impacting your ability to function.
